items.title: Fast-tracking genetic leads to reverse cellular aging
items.summary: Biologists use Co-Scientist to find novel factors that successfully rejuvenate human cells.
items.summaryZh: 阿布达耶-古滕伯格实验室使用Google DeepMind的Co-Scientist系统加速衰老研究。Co-Scientist通过扫描海量科学文献，提出了20多个用于逆转细胞衰老的新型基因因子假说，并在实验室测试中成功验证了部分因子的有效性，将原本需要数月的文献关联分析缩短至几天。

items.title: PaddleOCR 3.5: Running OCR and Document Parsing Tasks with a Transformers Backend
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: PaddleOCR 3.5发布，支持通过设置`engine="transformers"`将Hugging Face Transformers作为推理后端来运行OCR和文档解析任务。此更新为PP-OCRv5和PaddleOCR-VL 1.5等模型提供了更灵活的引擎接口，使其无缝契合Hugging Face生态环境。

aiReview.reasonZh: PaddleOCR 3.5版本引入了Hugging Face Transformers作为推理后端，增强了生态集成能力。

items.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments
items.summary: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise environments, helping enterprises deploy AI coding agents securely across data and workflows.
